purpose: Define executor-side conditions under which an externally produced primary JSON is admissible into the frozen cohort.

accepted_executor_classes.condition: A newly opened independent ChatGPT chat/model receives only the frozen standalone for that role; no project memory or prior project material is supplied as evidence/context.
A newly opened independent Claude chat/model receives only the frozen standalone for that role; no prior project conversation/output is supplied.
Automation can prove exact packet bytes/hash, fresh isolated model context, target role/model identity, no sibling/prior outputs, and immutable return capture.

not_accepted: a chat that has seen R2/V1.0.1/V1.0.2 factor outputs
a run that uses web search or extra project context
a rerun initiated because the first result was UNKNOWN/disagreement
a replacement model chosen after seeing a result
a model output missing required attestation or identity
intake_actions: preserve exact returned JSON before any parsing
validate against frozen schema and role
do not expose sibling output until both primary files are preserved
run only frozen comparator after both valid sibling outputs exist
